title: gaplike: exact inference on gapped and windowed stationary Gaussian data
description:
Joint signal and noise-parameter estimation for stationary Gaussian time series interrupted by data gaps.

gaplike provides gap-pattern generation (arbitrary patterns, tapered or rectangular), windowed frequency-domain covariances, and a hierarchy of likelihoods: the raw and window-power-scaled Whittle approximations, the exact convolved diagonal, the dense band-restricted windowed covariance, and the exact time-domain likelihood of the observed samples. The last is evaluated either in closed form, when the noise is linear in two component powers (simultaneous diagonalization, O(m) per evaluation), or matrix-free at arbitrary scale by preconditioned conjugate gradients, for which the covariance is never formed and one solve costs a few hundred FFT pairs.

This archive contains the package, its test suite, worked example notebooks, and the full reproduction pipeline for every figure of the accompanying paper, including the cached posterior chains.
